library.title: AI-Powered Learning Hub
library.subtitle: Upload PDF, DOCX, or TXT files so Gemini AI can summarize key concepts and craft custom quizzes.
library.uploadHint: Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT up to 20 MB. Scanned PDFs are transcribed automatically.
library.dropzone: Choose a file or drop it here
library.uploading: Gemini AI is reading and summarizing…

library.noQuizzes: No quizzes yet. Select a ready document to generate one!

quiz.rule1: Your browser will enter fullscreen as soon as you start.
quiz.rule2: Switching tabs, blurring the window, or pressing Esc logs a violation.
quiz.rule3: Each interruption deducts 5 points from your Focus Quality score.

plan.title: Personalized AI Learning Path
plan.subtitle: Gemini analyzes your weakest quiz topics and uploaded notes to craft a realistic spaced-repetition schedule.
plan.generating: Gemini AI is building your roadmap…
plan.emptyBody: Upload study notes, complete a quiz, or click Generate New AI Plan to get started.

admin.title: Admin Control Center
admin.subtitle: Monitor active users, inspect real-time presence, track login counts, and enforce 1-user-1-account access.

auth.loginSubtitle: Strict 1 user = 1 account policy. Signing in automatically closes any older active session.
auth.registerSubtitle: Each email address maps strictly to a single personal learning account.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with both letters and numbers.
auth.errSuspended: This account has been suspended by an administrator.
auth.errRevoked: Your session was closed because you signed in elsewhere or an admin ended it.
auth.errOAuthLinked: This email is already registered with another method (1 user = 1 account).
auth.errEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
auth.errWeakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain both letters and numbers.
auth.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
